reasons: EO12262 establishes an indefinite interagency Council. Annual reporting and quarterly meetings recur and do not terminate the body on a report deadline or actual report. Coordination, research, information-sharing, public hearings where feasible, continuing evaluation and administrative provisions contain no own-term sunset.

The original cites ERISA and Reorganization Plan4of1978 as the subject and administrative context; it does not delegate or implement a specifically identified statutory enforcement power. METHOD_STOP_02 does not require speculative amendment history for every provision of ERISA. EO12108 makes the Plan effective December31,1978; that earlier instrument neither creates this later Council nor terminates its duties.

EO12071 is the actual Pension Policy Commission establishing instrument, with staff authority and one-year sunset after effectiveness; EO12100 ratifies September21,1978 effectiveness and places staff appointment with its Chairman. Its source actually says the amendment is to ratify the effective functioning date, not a new November17 activation.

The OFR extension lead identifies PL96-14 May24,1979. Actual extension terms are unheld in observed outputs. Do not infer September1979 cessation before this order, a later report-based cessation, or August1982 as the first end of the explicitly named Executive Director seat. This is a concrete earlier-ending gap limited to membership1-102(i).

The other fifteen original units are continuing commands with no located earlier legal cessation; August17,1982 express revocation is supportable for them. The Council first-end problem is distinct from whether its establishing authority has formally ended by August17,1982.

EO12379 section9 expressly revokes EO12262; section1 also revokes EO12071 as amended. Complete order throughsection25/signature contains no target saving or deferred effective date. The preamble inactive-or-no-longer-necessary recital does not independently date a legal cessation.

EO13813,13847,13868,14030,14273,14330,14366 assign distinct healthcare, retirement, energy-investment, climate-risk or proxy-advice functions to agencies. All were read in full. None reestablishes or transfers this Council, or supplies an earlier event in its1981-82 lifespan.

Council-derived duties cease with the Council; ERISA benefit entitlements and independent agency powers are not created or extinguished by this order. Separate Pension Commission/staff powers are not residual EO12262 Council commands. No Council-specific saving located in held original/revoker/dependency orders.
